summary: Sad to see @malexandrou Ultimate Category Excluder plug-in is no longer supported. Thanks for the work you did. Many in the #indieweb WordPress community relied on the plug-in. If others have a favorite category excluder plugin I welcome recommendations.
author: Greg McVerry
body_html: Sad to see @malexandrou Ultimate Category Excluder plug-in is no longer supported. Thanks for the work you did. Many in the #indieweb WordPress community relied on the plug-in. If others have a favorite category excluder plugin I welcome recommendations.
